m15.note: Plain M15 spell frame. c is a TRUE colorless (non-artifact) reference; artifacts live on m15artifact.

m15artifact.note: Non-legendary prints only — legendary artifacts carry the crown flourish our frame doesn't draw. Coloured artifacts verify the colour border blend + silver interior.

m15land.note: Basics for w/u/b/r/g, Wastes for c. m is a five-colour gold-plate nonbasic (Command Tower); true dual lands blend two colours, which our single m frame can't express.

m15tokenartifact.note: Printed artifact tokens are colourless (Treasure/Clue/Food…); coloured artifact tokens are rare finds from Universes Beyond token sets.

m15snow.note: Gold snow spells only exist as legendaries (crown) — the m reference is accepted with that caveat.

m15devoid.note: Devoid cards are colourless by rule; the frame colour follows the identity. c is a true-colorless Eldrazi (no devoid colourless print exists).

m15borderless.note: The 2019+ borderless frame (Card Conjurer 'Borderless (Alt)', frames plan 4.32): art to the edges, dark translucent bars and box, white ink, a black bottom bar. Short then long text per colour (TODO 4.32's list, revised by the 2026-09-26 print review: IKO #377 (Godzilla-series layout), CMM #697 (a different treatment), SOS #294 (a Lesson emblem moves the name), MH3 #328 (a blue devoid card, not c), FRA #461 and TLA #306 (two-colour pinlines) were replaced). m = three-colour prints, the uniform gold pinline our master draws: two-colour prints split the pinline between their colours (4.6). No crowned (legendary) printing until 4.6's floating crown. Rares and mythics print the holo stamp in an ARCH of the rules-box pinline (4.9); our master's pinline is straight, so the score masks the arch (lib/frames/score-combo.ts). The card edge has no pinlines: score on the bars and the bottom bar.

m15borderlessartifact.note: c = Card Conjurer's artifact (A) frame; w/u/b/r/g/m = the colour frames, as FDN #295/#296, FRA #327 and 2XM #341 print them. Some coloured borderless artifacts print silver artifact bars instead (SNC #285/#288, SLC #2011): confirm the thumbnail. DFT #318 is a Vehicle (its P/T plate is 4.6's). The m references are TWO-colour prints with a split pinline (no three-colour borderless artifact was found): leave m unverified until 4.6 builds the two-colour pinline. The holo-stamp arch is masked from the score, as on m15borderless.

agclassic.note: c paints two masters: a colourless ARTIFACT (card type Artifact, or Artifact in the supertype) the brown artifact card (a.png), any other colourless card the grey one (c.png). Verifying c publishes both. Jayemdae Tome (Artifact) renders on the brown card; Battering Ram (Artifact Creature) imports without its Artifact word until TODO 1.7, so it renders on the grey one. Alpha printed no colourless non-artifact: eyeball the grey card on a colourless creature in the creator.

m15fullartland.note: Black-bordered full-art basics with the title bar and the left-disc type bar (Card Conjurer 'Fullart Basics (2022)', frames plan 4.39; printed since P23). References are the 2024–25 printings (FDN, TDM, DSK, DFT), which match the master within 2 px (print review 2026-09-26); the 2023 ONE #262–266 and MOM #282–290 print an older bar geometry (bars 6–13 px off, colours up to 43 levels) and are the `nearest` look only. c: FIN #309 is the one printed left-disc Wastes (its bars are darker than the master's: owner sign-off on the tone). UB printings (FIN) add a triangle stamp (4.9). m: no basic is multicolour.

fullartland.note: Borderless full-art basics (owner decision 4.35(a), references revised 2026-09-26): FRA #382–396 are the only borderless printings with this title bar + left-disc type bar. They print DARK (inverted) bars and this frame keeps light ones (owner decision), so they check geometry only and resolve `nearest`. c: the one left-disc Wastes (FIN #309) is black-bordered, so m15fullartland's; no borderless one (owner visual sign-off); m: no basic is multicolour.

tarkirdragon.note: Dragon Wing = the Multiverse Legends (MOM 2023) Tarkir frame, not a Tarkir: Dragonstorm frame. Only MUL #1 Anafenza (W) and #60 Taigam (W/U) were printed; 'm' is Taigam, whose two colours split the wings (white left, blue right) with a gold P/T plate, so it tests the two-colour look — the 3+ colour gold-wing look was never printed. Both are legendary and show MSE's legend crown, which PipGlyph does not draw.
